title: Synthesis of Mn-ofloxacin complex, experimental and in silico DNA binding evaluation, biological activity assessment.
authors: Nasiri, Negar; Hosseinzadeh, Leila; Vahedpour, Teymour; Alizadeh, Ali Akbar; Ahmadi, Farhad
one_liner_zh: 该文研究Mn-氧氟沙星配合物的合成及其与DNA的结合模式，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但对象为小分子-DNA，非TF-DNA体系，且方法以实验为主、in silico为辅，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模深度。
abstract: Metal-fluoroquinolones have more antibacterial and cytotoxic effects compared to free fluoroquinolones. In this work, a bidentated Mn (II) complex with ofloxacin (MOC) was synthesized and its cytotoxicity activity, oxidative stress and DNA binding were studied. Anti- proliferative and cytotoxic tests revealed that MOC exhibits better anti proliferative and cytotoxic activities compared to OFL which was attributed to the more interaction of MOC with DNA. Therefore, the interaction of MOC with DNA was investigated by using voltammetry, UV-Vis, fluorescence, and in silico methods. The results revealed that MOC interacts with DNA via electrostatic and outside hydrogen binding via minor groove. The proposed DNA binding modes may support the greater in-vitro cytotoxicity of MOC compared to OFL alone.
abstract_zh: 金属-氟喹诺酮类化合物相较于游离氟�诺酮具有更强的抗菌和细胞毒性效应。本研究合成了一种双齿配位的锰（II）配合物，其配体为氧氟沙星（MOC），并对其细胞毒性活性、氧化应激及DNA结合特性进行了研究。抗增殖和细胞毒性测试表明，MOC相较于OFL表现出更好的抗增殖和细胞毒性活性，这归因于MOC与DNA的更强相互作用。因此，采用伏安法、紫外-可见光谱、荧光光谱及计算机模拟方法研究了MOC与DNA的相互作用。结果显示，MOC通过静电作用及外部氢键结合于DNA小沟。所提出的DNA结合模式可能支持MOC相较于单独OFL具有更高体外细胞毒性的结论。
